name: Tremor
description: Tremor channels the raw force of an earthquake into a colossal weapon. Its slow and heavy attacks devastate groups of enemies through massive shockwaves and overwhelming knockback. After reaching its deliberate collapse at Phase 6, Tremor rebuilds itself into an increasingly destructive force, culminating in a weapon capable of unleashing a gigantic Seismic Wave across the battlefield.

phases.name: Phase 1: Rumble
phases.effects: A crude stone-and-metal slab. Slow, heavy, and grounding. Base 30,000 DMG and 300,000 HP.
phases.notification: Something beneath the earth has awakened.

phases.name: Phase 2: Quake
phases.effects: Dense dark stone blade laced with small glowing fissures. Base 85,000 DMG and 850,000 HP.

phases.name: Phase 3: Fault
phases.effects: Tectonic fractures split along the spine, sending shockwaves through the earth. Base 180,000 DMG and 1,700,000 HP.

phases.name: Phase 4: Rupture
phases.effects: Volcanic magma leaks through jagged rocky edges, shattering enemy formations. Base 360,000 DMG and 3,200,000 HP.

phases.name: Phase 5: Cataclysm
phases.effects: Colossal black stone core with roaring orange fissures. Subterranean tremors follow every step. Base 620,000 DMG and 5,500,000 HP.
phases.notification: This is no longer a tremor.

phases.name: Phase 6: Collapse
phases.effects: DELIBERATE COLLAPSE — The tectonic pressure vents prematurely. The stone crumbles into brittle dead basalt. Unlocks Seismic Wave [Z]: launch a travelling wave dealing 10× damage across hordes. Base 60,000 DMG and 500,000 HP.

phases.name: Phase 7: Aftershock
phases.effects: The earth surges back with violent aftershocks. Each swing creates secondary shockwaves behind targets. Base 1,050,000 DMG and 8,500,000 HP.
phases.notification: You thought the shaking had stopped?

phases.name: Phase 8: Earthshatter
phases.effects: A giant tectonic slab wrapped in orbiting boulder fragments. Creates deep fissures across the battlefield. Base 2,100,000 DMG and 14,000,000 HP.

phases.name: Phase 9: Worldbreaker
phases.effects: Monumental molten stone blade. The impact reverberates through the entire combat arena. Base 3,600,000 DMG and 21,000,000 HP.
phases.notification: Mountains are only obstacles until they break.

phases.name: Phase 10: Tremor
phases.effects: FINAL TRANSFORMATION — The ultimate embodiment of seismic catastrophe. Devastating full half-circle AoE swings with massive knockback. Overwhelming raw power exceeding Sanguine by 43%. Base 7,475,000 DMG and 32,000,000 HP.
